summary: A long-running move finally reached its decisive stage in 2023, with Jude Bellingham leaving Borussia Dortmund for Real Madrid. The transfer became one of the defining moves of the summer and began a new chapter for the England midfielder in Spain.

Harry Kane's Tottenham chapter ended in 2023 after a lengthy transfer saga. The England striker moved to Bayern Munich, taking his goalscoring record to Germany and beginning a new phase of his career away from north London.

Declan Rice became one of the major Premier League moves of summer 2023. After his final season as West Ham captain, the midfielder moved across London to Arsenal and became a major part of their midfield plans.

Moisés Caicedo's move to Chelsea followed an extended Premier League transfer battle. The midfielder eventually left Brighton for Stamford Bridge, becoming one of the headline signings of the 2023 summer window.

Robert Lewandowski's transfer from Bayern Munich to Barcelona was one of the defining moves of the 2022 summer window. The Polish striker left Germany after an exceptional spell and moved to Spain to lead Barcelona's attack.

Erling Haaland left Borussia Dortmund for Manchester City in one of the most anticipated transfers of 2022. The Norwegian striker arrived in England with an exceptional scoring record and immediately became the centrepiece of City's attack.

Cristiano Ronaldo's next destination became one of football's biggest stories at the end of 2022. After leaving Manchester United, the Portuguese forward moved to Al Nassr and began a new chapter in Saudi Arabia.

Kylian Mbappé finally joined Real Madrid in 2024 after years of speculation surrounding a move to the Spanish club. The French forward left Paris Saint-Germain and arrived in Madrid as one of world football's most recognisable players.
